Call your local emergency number if a headache comes with any of these:

string-array.name: settings_warning_signs_list
string-array.item: Extremely bad pain that came on suddenly
Weakness or loss of movement on one side of your body or face
Losing your vision, or blurred or double vision
A very high temperature and signs of meningitis, such as a stiff neck
A rash that doesn\'t fade when you press a glass against it (this may be harder to see on brown or black skin)
A head injury in the last 3 months

resources.string: Don\'t drive yourself to hospital. Call your local emergency number.
Get urgent medical advice if you have a migraine attack and:

string-array.name: settings_warning_signs_urgent_list
string-array.item: It has lasted longer than 72 hours
Aura symptoms last longer than 1 hour at a time
You\'re pregnant or have just had a baby

resources.string: If you have any other symptoms you\'re worried about, get urgent medical advice.
Migrely is a headache diary. It helps you keep a record of your migraines, the medications you take and what might set them off, so you can see patterns and talk them over with your doctor.
Migrely is not a medical device. It doesn\'t diagnose, treat or prevent any condition, and nothing in it is medical advice. Its counts and patterns come only from what you logged.
Talk to a doctor about your headaches, and before you start, stop or change a medication.
If a headache comes with any of the emergency signs on the Warning signs page, call your local emergency number.
Migrely has no internet permission, so the app itself cannot send anything over the internet. There\'s no account to make and nothing to sign in to.
Premium is bought through Google Play, which goes online for the purchase.

Your entries stay on this phone. If Android\'s own backup is on, it may also copy them to your Google account. On Android 9 and later, it does that only when it can encrypt the copy end to end, which needs a screen lock. On Android 8, Migrely cannot require that, so the copy may not be end-to-end encrypted. Android can also move your entries to a new phone when you set it up.

Apart from Android\'s own backup and moving to a new phone, your entries leave the phone only in a file you export yourself: a backup, a spreadsheet or a report for your doctor. That file goes wherever you send it.
Delete all data, at the end of Settings, removes everything Migrely keeps on this phone.
